reasoning_content: One process with a ready probe isn't "Ready" but that's likely `llm-client` which has ready="-" and is Running. Let me check which ones. Actually llm-client shows ready="-". Let me check if it has a ready probe. The guide says external LLM is not part of local stack (placeholder). Let me inspect.

action.command:
curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/processes | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const d=JSON.parse(s).data;d.filter(p=>p.has_ready_probe&&p.is_ready!=="Ready").forEach(p=>console.log(p.name,p.status,p.is_ready,p.exit_code));console.log("--- llm-client detail ---");const l=d.find(p=>p.name==="llm-client");console.log(JSON.stringify(l));})'
echo "=== llm-client definition ==="; cd /workspace && sed -n '/^  llm-client:/,/readiness_probe/p' process-compose.yaml | head -40

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8080/processes | node -e 'let s=\"\";process.stdin.on(\"data\",d=>s+=d).on(\"end\",()=>{const d=JSON.parse(s).data;d.filter(p=>p.has_ready_probe&&p.is_ready!==\"Ready\").forEach(p=>console.log(p.name,p.status,p.is_ready,p.exit_code));console.log(\"--- llm-client detail ---\");const l=d.find(p=>p.name===\"llm-client\");console.log(JSON.stringify(l));})'\necho \"=== llm-client definition ===\"; cd /workspace && sed -n '/^  llm-client:/,/readiness_probe/p' process-compose.yaml | head -40", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Identify non-ready probed process"}
